title: HERB: Measuring Hierarchical Regional Bias in Pre-trained Language Models
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as its experiments and methodology are exclusively focused on measuring hierarchical regional bias.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith/religion. The paper mentions 'religious bias' as an example of a previously studied societal bias to contextualize its primary focus, which is the measurement of regional bias in language models.
